# WM Salon Sovereign Hub

> WordPress plugin with two calculators for hair salons: the booth-rent (Stuhlmiete) revenue split between a salon and an independent stylist, computed in whole cents, and an INCI ingredient checker (5 sulfates, 6 silicones, 5 parabens, 8 fragrance allergens), each as a shortcode, a public REST route (`wm-salon/v1`) and a WP-CLI command (`wp salon`).

## Overview

`wm-salon-sovereign-hub` (v1.1.2) is a WordPress plugin developed with an agentic workflow (AI coding agents). It uses no custom database tables, makes no external request, throttles anonymous REST requests via HMAC-SHA256 IP transients, preserves options on uninstall unless `wm_salon_delete_data_on_uninstall` is explicitly enabled, exposes WordPress 6.5+ Block Bindings (`wm-salon/metrics`) and GenerateBlocks 2.x dynamic tag (`{{wm_salon_metric}}`), and registers as a spoke of the WM Suite Hub when the hub is active. The calculators give figures, not legal or regulatory verdicts: the split calculator does not assess self-employment, and the INCI checker does not check which allergen has to be declared.

## Standards & Compliance

- PHP 8.1+ with strict types; WordPress coding style
- Zero-CDN: the stylesheet ships in `assets/css/`, nothing is loaded from another host
- Late escaping; REST arguments validated against a schema (400 on missing or malformed input)
- DSGVO/GDPR: no personal data stored
- Version 1.2.1.
